charts.title: Total industry value added from sports and recreation activities in Australia from financial year 2010 to 2023 (in billion Australian dollars)
charts.short: Total industry value added from sports and recreation in Australia FY 2010-2023
charts.description: Sports and recreation activities in Australia contributed over nine billion Australian dollars to the Australian economy in financial year 2023. This was a large increase in comparison to the 2020 financial year, which saw slightly over six billion Australian dollars of value added to the national economy.
charts.note: Australia, Australia and Oceania; financial year 2010 to 2023

charts.title: Number of persons employed in sports and recreation activities in Australia from financial year 2012 to 2023 (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Persons employed by the sports and recreation industry in Australia FY 2012-2023
charts.description: In financial year 2023, a total of 162,000 people were employed in the sports and recreation activities industry in Australia. Over the past decade, industry employment numbers have fluctuated, with numbers dropping to under 120,000 in the 2016 and 2017 financial years.
charts.note: Australia, Australia and Oceania; financial years 2012 to 2023

charts.title: Key financial figures of the sports and recreation activities industry in Australia in financial year 2023 (in billion Australian dollars)
charts.short: Sports and recreation industry financial figures in Australia FY 2023
charts.description: In financial year 2023, the total income of the sports and recreation activities industry in Australia amounted to around 26 billion Australian dollars. This resulted in an earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization of close to three billion Australian dollars.
charts.note: Australia, Australia and Oceania; financial year 2023
charts.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics Value in billion Australian dollars
categories: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization

charts.description: In the 2023 financial year, it was estimated that approximately 87.4 percent of adults in Australia participated in sport at least once a year. Significantly fewer people under the age of 18 and people in the 55 to 64 year old age group attended a gym, sports or leisure center.
